sloka: राजधानी यमस्य एषा कष्टेन तमसा आवृता ।एतावत् एव युष्माभिः वीरा वानर पुंगवाः ।शक्यम् विचेतुम् गन्तुम् वा न अतो गतिमताम् गतिः ॥४-४१-४५॥
transliteration: rājadhānī yamasya eṣā kaṣṭena tamasā āvṛtā ।etāvat eva yuṣmābhiḥ vīrā vānara puṁgavāḥ ।śakyam vicetum gantum vā na ato gatimatām gatiḥ ॥4-41-45॥

translations.english: 'The divine people who have earned a place in heaven stay there at the end of their life on earth. Beyond, lies the dreadful world of deceased ancestors. It is not possible for you to enter that place.
